description: Phase 2: CMS Extension - Add 'data-policy' and 'information-policy' slugs to the CMS page model enum so admins can create and mobile can display these new policy pages
steps: 1. In backend/src/modules/admin/cmsPage.model.js, add 'data-policy' and 'information-policy' to the slug enum array. Current enum: ['privacy-policy', 'about-us', 'terms-conditions', 'community-guidelines', 'creator-listing-policy', 'copyright-policy']. New enum should include both new values at the end.

2. In mobile/src/screens/profile/SettingsScreen.tsx, add the two new CMS pages to the CMS_PAGES array so they appear in the Settings list. Add: { title: 'Data Policy', slug: 'data-policy' } and { title: 'Information Policy', slug: 'information-policy' }.
acceptance_criteria: cmsPage.model.js slug enum includes 'data-policy' and 'information-policy' (8 total slugs)
SettingsScreen.tsx CMS_PAGES array includes both new entries with correct slugs and titles
Existing CMS pages still work (no enum values removed)
The admin CMS editor already works generically with any slug - no admin changes needed
The mobile CmsPageScreen already renders any slug generically - no mobile renderer changes needed
verification: Read cmsPage.model.js and confirm enum array has 8 entries including data-policy and information-policy
Read SettingsScreen.tsx and confirm CMS_PAGES has 8 entries
findings: Simple data addition. Added 'data-policy' and 'information-policy' to backend enum (8 total) and corresponding entries to mobile CMS_PAGES array. No logic changes needed - the CMS system handles any slug generically.
